title: Does coupling an AI-inference layer to a human-verification layer cause a first-order catastrophic collapse (mutual percolation), not graceful degradation?
why: Test as Buldyrev-style interdependent percolation; falsifier: no discontinuous jump in the mutual giant component at realistic partial coupling.

title: Does critical slowing down make a late strike-when-critical push cheaper than constant forcing to flip a bistable collective?
why: Compare min time-integrated effort across forcing schedules on a double-well; falsifier: critical schedule is not cheaper than constant.

title: At what learning/exploration threshold do independent pricing algorithms tip into tacit collusion?
why: Q-learning pricing agents; falsifier: no supra-competitive price band emerges as exploration falls.

title: Does network disorder create a Griffiths phase, a broad band of power-law contagion, instead of a single epidemic threshold?
why: Contagion on disordered networks; falsifier: a sharp single threshold with no extended power-law band.

title: How much does ecological (aggregate-to-individual) inference leak inflate confidence above accuracy, and where?
why: Measure the confidence-accuracy gap vs the ecological mixing parameter; falsifier: no systematic over-confidence from the leak.

title: How should optimal conservatism scale with uncertainty about a source's own validity (meta-uncertainty)?
why: Bayesian update with uncertain likelihood reliability; falsifier: conservatism does not increase with validity-variance.

title: Below what base accuracy does self-consistency / majority voting AMPLIFY error instead of reducing it?
why: Vary base accuracy and votes k; falsifier: voting never crosses over to amplifying error.

title: Do retrieval/association cascades self-organize to criticality with power-law avalanche sizes?
why: Self-organized criticality model of retrieval; falsifier: avalanche sizes are not power-law (no SOC).

title: In an O-ring production process, when does automating one step FLIP from raising to lowering total output?
why: O-ring production function with automation reliability; falsifier: automation never flips sign across the reliability range.

title: Is there an interior optimal number of metrics K* in a basket beyond which Goodhart gaming backfires?
why: Vary basket size K under strategic gaming; falsifier: more metrics monotonically help (no interior optimum).

title: Does citation bandwagoning lock in false claims that independent evaluation would have filtered?
why: Compare P(false claim survives) under bandwagon vs independent evaluation; falsifier: bandwagoning does not raise false-survival.
